description.vi: Mo hinh Soft Soil phu hop cho dat set mem gan NC (normally consolidated), but non, va dat huu co. Dung ham nang luong logarit de mo ta bien dang the tich.
description.en: Soft Soil model suitable for near-NC clays, soft clay, peat. Uses logarithmic volumetric strain law.

lambda_star.name: Modified compression index
lambda_star.note: Primary loading – equivalent to Cc in oedometer compression curve

kappa_star.name: Modified swelling index
kappa_star.note: Factor 2 applied vs Cam-Clay formula because PLAXIS assumes isotropic K0=1 unloading; Cs from oedometer or swelling test

lambda_kappa_ratio.note: Usually 5–7 for soft clays, 2.5–4 for stiff OC clays

phi.name: Effective friction angle
phi.note: Use CU effective or CD direct shear

psi.name: Dilatancy angle
psi.note: Negligible for soft soils – always set to 0 for NC/soft clays

K0_nc.name: NC lateral earth pressure coefficient
K0_nc.note: Jaky (1944); PLAXIS computes this automatically from φ if not overridden

M.name: Slope of critical state line in p'-q space
M.formula_exact: Eq. 234 (Brinkgreve 1994): function of K0_nc, νur, λ*/κ*
M.note: Eq. 235 (approximate) sufficient for most practical cases

OCR.name: Over-Consolidation Ratio
OCR.note: Per layer at mid-depth; σ'v0 = effective overburden at layer midpoint

POP.name: Pre-Overburden Pressure
POP.note: Alternative to OCR in PLAXIS; POP = 0 means NC, POP > 0 means OC

kappa_star_from_oedometer.note: Factor 2 = PLAXIS convention (assumes K0=1 during isotropic unloading)

Cs_fallback.note: Fallback when Cs not measured; typical Cs/Cc ≈ 0.10–0.25 for soft clays

M_approx.source: Eq. 235 – PLAXIS Material Models Manual Ch. 10

M_exact.python_note: Solve for M numerically; Eq. 234 Brinkgreve 1994
M_exact.source: Eq. 234 – PLAXIS Material Models Manual Ch. 10

sigma_v0_at_mid.python_note: Integrate effective unit weight from surface to layer midpoint; subtract gamma_w below GWT

zone_PA2_defaults.note: Zone-representative params = weighted avg by layer thickness, all selected BHs per zone
